from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import sys

W,H=900,420
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),(255,255,255))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
except Exception:
    font=None

def text(x,y,s,fill=(0,0,0),size=22):
    if font:
        d.text((x,y),s,fill=fill,font=font)
    else:
        d.text((x,y),s,fill=fill)

text(20,20,'Settings',fill=(0,0,0))
text(20,60,'LOOK',fill=(0,0,0))
text(40,90,'Screen: Cassette',fill=(0,0,0))
text(40,120,'Variant: color scheme',fill=(0,0,0))
text(40,160,'Group: DISPLAY',fill=(0,0,0))
text(60,190,'Cassette variant controls appear here',fill=(100,100,100))

# draw a simple box around the region
box=(30,78,860,205)
d.rectangle(box,outline=(0,0,0))

img.save('/workspace/screenshot_settings_cassette.png')
print('OK')
